note: Luzerne County's zoning districts for county-zoned municipalities are published only in the subscription GIS portal (luzernecounty.azurewebsites.net, paid 1-day/30-day/1-year plans), not the free public portal or PASDA/county MapServer. The 2023 county zoning map is a PDF. No zoning layer was found for Wilkes-Barre or Hazleton: the city zoning pages link only PDFs, ordinances, and third-party maps. The Zoning_Districts FeatureServer found at services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd is not Luzerne data (no features at county points; its districts such as RF-4 and SF-20/ANSA are from another jurisdiction).
